capabilities: Mark flashcards with a card tag and export them to a .mochi file
Preview card count, deck name and image count before exporting
Bundle local image embeds into the archive and rewrite their links
Export a single note or a whole folder as one or multiple decks
Define named export presets for tag, output folder and deck name
extras: Pro features (folder export, sub-decks, presets) require a GitHub Sponsors sponsorship ($5/month or $15 one-time) verified via GitHub sign-in; core export is free. The FAQ admits the author did not test importing the archive into Mochi for this release. After updates the plugin opens a promotional 'What's new' tab suggesting other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to produce .mochi archive files, so flashcards written in notes cannot be imported into Mochi directly.

relations.evidence: turns flashcards in your Obsidian notes into a .mochi file for the Mochi spaced repetition app

summary: Export plugin that converts tagged flashcard lines in a note, plus their local images, into a .mochi archive file for the Mochi spaced repetition app.
